kept.text: LATAM announced the termination of its direct service between Sydney and Santiago via Auckland.
kept.quote: LATAM will drop its service from Sydney to Santiago via Auckland later this year. From October, the Chilean carrier will axe the Sydney–Auckland fifth-freedom leg of its Sydney–Santiago service, leaving the non-stop Sydney–Santiago and Auckland–Santiago services in place.

dropped.text: From 13 July 2017, Emirates suspended its daily EK418 and EK419 A380 flights between Sydney and Auckland, with those flights replaced by Qantas A330 services.
